name: @canopy/frontend
description: Electron + React + TypeScript client. Connects to the controller service.
//postinstall_note: Electron 42 dropped its install-time download and fetches the runtime lazily on the first require('electron'). electron-vite reads node_modules/electron/path.txt directly and never triggers that, so it fails with 'Error: Electron uninstall'. install-electron is electron's own downloader and is a no-op once the runtime is present. ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD (the variable Electron's old installer honoured) skips it, for CI jobs that only typecheck and test.
//dependencies_note: Everything is a devDependency: electron-vite bundles the renderer, and main and preload import only electron and node builtins, so the packaged app needs no node_modules. electron-builder ships whatever is under dependencies, so keep that empty.
